title: Body composition
description: Smart-scale weigh-ins in InfluxDB BodyStats (body_composition, body_levels, body_thresholds), per user: the latest reading of each metric coloured by its level, a detail row per metric, and the history by source.

panels.title: Weight

targets.query: SELECT "weight_kg" AS "weight" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT moving_average("weight_kg", 5) AS "trend" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT "weight" / 1000 AS "weight" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT moving_average("weight", 5) / 1000 AS "trend" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Every weigh-in (points) and a moving average of the last 5 (line), one colour per source: two scales are two lines, never one.

panels.title: Body composition (kg)

targets.query: SELECT "fat_free_weight_kg" AS "fat-free mass" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT "weight_kg" * "body_fat_pct" / 100 AS "fat mass" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT "weight" / 1000 * (1 - "bodyFat" / 100) AS "fat-free mass" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT "weight" / 1000 * "bodyFat" / 100 AS "fat mass" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Weight split into fat-free mass and fat mass (weight × body fat %); the top of the stack is the weight.
